title: cross-org-initiative-timeline-weaving-and-escalation-decision-tree
creator: Priya Patel
description: Purpose: Define a repeatable, low-friction process for converting company-level OKRs into synchronized initiative timelines across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM. Deliver a decision tree and escalation matrix to resolve scheduling conflicts, resource contention, and priority drift during quarterly planning and mid-cycle adjustments. This ticket captures scope, milestones, owners, and a lightweight playbook for the pilot roll-out in Q2 2025.
objectives: Create a canonical mapping from company OKRs to release lanes and squad-level milestones
Design an escalation decision tree that reduces ambiguous priority calls and shortens resolution time to <72 hours
Pilot the timeline-weaving playbook with two cross-functional initiatives and measure adherence and friction
success_metrics: % of company OKR-linked initiatives with aligned sprint milestones >= 90%
Average time to resolve priority conflicts via escalation tree <= 72 hours
Stakeholder satisfaction score for planning process (post-pilot survey) >= 8/10
Reduction in mid-cycle scope churn attributable to unclear ownership by >= 30%
scope: Define mapping rules (OKR -> initiative -> release lane)
Publish a decision tree with clear escalation tiers and owners
Build a one-page playbook and checklist for PMs and Eng leads
Run a 6-week pilot with Product, Serving Runtime Eng, Design, and Customer Success
Instrument tracker dashboard in Redwood Console for milestone alignment signals
out_of_scope: Automating ticket creation across all teams (future work)
Changing existing sprint cadences for squads
Formal headcount allocation or budget approval processes
